notes:
POC summary and customer signals:
- Company: mid-market SaaS (support/knowledge) — needs predictable latency + control over data residency.
- Current state: positive on hosted API (fast onboarding) but want Dedicated for SLA, VPC peering, and long-term unit economics.
- Primary workloads: agent chat (low-latency), doc search (embeddings), reranking pipeline for search results.
- Targets: p95 <150ms chat, 200 qps sustained for peak flows, cost sensitivity medium-high (looking to reduce token unit cost after migration).
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged retention policy agreement.

POC technical plan (agreed in architecture call):
- Duration: 30 days Dedicated POC (staged).
- Canary plan: start with 5% of production traffic -> 20% after 72h -> 50% after 7 days -> full traffic on success. Canary windows include quality checks and latency SLIs.
- Model variants: primary model = quantized medium-size open model (cost/latency sweet spot); fallback model = small quantized variant for SLO-preserving degradation; hosted API variant retained as emergency fallback.
- Routing & failover: smart routing policy in config: route by region + capacity. Primary region = us-east-1 (customer infra), failover = eu-west-1 for EU traffic; cross-region failover window tested during POC. Automatic fallback to hosted_api when Dedicated capacity exhausted.
- Rollback procedure: traffic reweighting via console (canary -> previous weights), preset rollback policy to cut traffic to 0% for Dedicated within 60s if p95 latency or error rate breaches thresholds.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95/p99 latency, trace ids. Customer wants 30d retention on traces for the POC period (ask for premium observability add-on).

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Interested in monthly reserved capacity with 6–12 month commit if POC successful. Finance requested committed pricing bands + overage rules.
- Forecast guidance: internal ops wants decision by 2025-11 for year-start budget.

Quotes and direct notes from stakeholders:
- Head of Product: "Need predictable p95 for chat; we can tolerate quality drops if latency stays low".
- CTO: "We need clear rollback and failover so customer-facing chat never goes down."

Open items / immediate next actions:
- SE to finalize canary %s and gating SLOs (Liam).
- Security to provide formal KMS integration doc and updated data residency SLA (Samira to follow up).
- Finance to send Dedicated pricing deck and a draft MSA addendum (drive link).
- Schedule POC kickoff (target 2025-09-08).
